architecture: Motion-conditioned kernel ridge regression of full 23-joint temporal curve coefficients; independent NumPy implementation
baseline: linear root and local quaternion SLERP through complete ancestor hierarchy
selection: Validation position + 0.1 * geodesic rotation; full FK zero-residual baseline remains a selectable candidate. No hidden validation motion is used in coefficient training.
notes: V1 confirmation clips are observed development data; new results there are exploratory, not fresh confirmation.
No new datasets, packages, paid compute or runtime changes.
Full local hierarchy removes physical bone stretching, while collapsed semantic lengths can vary with intermediate joint motion.
All existing position/rotation/velocity/semantic-length/cohort gates retained; acceleration and true-edge gates added.
Capacity audit uses hidden labels only as a diagnostic; all predictor targets are fitted from training windows exclusively.
Raw-pose versus motion-relative features and linear versus RBF regression are frozen controlled comparisons.
Kernel inference tends to zero residual outside training support; this is not proof of safe generalization.
No fresh blind test corpus has been established; old confirmation remains observed development data.
training_objective: Cohort-weighted regularized regression of complete curve coefficients fitted from training labels; temporal errors are acceptance metrics, not direct regression loss terms.
